page.content:
2015 musical that opened at the Public and then the Richard Rodgers Theatre.

How Hamilton (musical) connects

  • Artist: Lin-Manuel Miranda — Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote the book, music, and lyrics of Hamilton.
  • Topic: Hamilton — Hamilton the musical is the central work of this subject.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Alexander Hamilton is the title figure of the musical.
  • Work: Alexander Hamilton (Chernow) — Hamilton the musical is adapted from Ron Chernow's biography.
  • Location: Richard Rodgers Theatre — Hamilton's Broadway run is at the Richard Rodgers Theatre.
  • Character: Aaron Burr — Aaron Burr narrates Hamilton and fires the last shot.
  • Work: Alexander Hamilton (Chernow) — Chernow's Alexander Hamilton was adapted into the musical.
  • Location: The Public Theater — Hamilton premiered Off-Broadway at the Public Theater.
  • Faction: the Schuyler sisters — The Schuyler sisters are the family trio at the center of Hamilton's private plot.
  • Creator: Thomas Kail — Thomas Kail directed Hamilton from the Public to Broadway.
  • Work: Cabinet Battle — The Cabinet Battles are set-piece songs inside Hamilton.
  • Work: My Shot — My Shot is Hamilton's first-act I-want song.
  • Work: The Room Where It Happens — The Room Where It Happens is Burr's second-act showpiece.
  • Character: George Washington — George Washington is the general and president of the musical.
  • Work: Yorktown (The World Turned Upside Down) — Yorktown closes the Revolution half of Hamilton.
  • Work: Ten Duel Commandments — Ten Duel Commandments teaches the code the later duels use.

What is Hamilton (musical)?

Hamilton the musical is Miranda, Kail, and company's sung-through piece: Off-Broadway at the Public Theater in 2015, then Broadway at the Richard Rodgers, Tony-winning, later filmed for Disney+.

Key threads lead to Lin-Manuel Miranda, Hamilton, Alexander Hamilton, Alexander Hamilton (Chernow), Richard Rodgers Theatre and Aaron Burr.
